attributes.content: Proper ingredients, from generations of mums

attributes.text: The same four have gone into postpartum food for generations, from Pakistan to West Africa. No shortcuts, no preservatives.
“My story with lactation cookies started when my friend started struggling with breastfeeding her newborn.”

At the time, we had no choice but to start making lactation cookies ourselves, praying that it would work for the sake of her baby and amazingly, it did! These cookies helped her milk supply almost immediately and I was so grateful to have been able to make her early motherhood days just a bit easier.
Now I hope that I can do the same thing for you. Using natural, wholesome ingredients, everything is made with care and intention for breastfeeding mums and their new beautiful babies.

attributes.content: Loved by mums, and the people who love them

attributes.text: I received the strawberry and milk chocolate chip cookies. I gave half of them to my SIL, who is also postpartum. They were fresh, soft and delicious! … I think these would be lovely to gift a new Mum.
Sweet, soft oat cookies that are seriously addictive—and perfect for a lactating mum who’s constantly hungry. … The cookies are generously sized, so one was usually enough to keep me full.
I was gifted these lactation cookies right after giving birth … They were such a comforting treat during those early postpartum days and made me feel really supported as a new mum.

attributes.content: I met Mama’s Munches at the Summer Souk

attributes.text: The cookies were absolutely delicious! I had my stall next to hers and I swear I ate half of her strawberry and chocolate cookies ahaha! … What a treat for postpartum mums

attributes.content: Such a healthy and yummy treat

attributes.text: We bought the marshmallow and raisin one and my little one absolutely demolished them! Will deffo be buying more in the future!
The cookies were soo delicious and filling! I have nearly finished half the box and I only bought them two days ago!
